at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.npc: Ahoy! I'm Cap'n Pudi, currently assisting the Spirit Anglers in their effort against Tempoross.

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.player: Tempoross? Spirit Anglers? Who are they?

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.npc: You 'aven't heard?! The freak storms? Sailors running into trouble? Ye really must be a landlubber!
Tempoross is some kind o' great sea spirit that's been spookin' sailors and causing crazy storms!
Taiman and his crew were one of the first t' run into it. Washed up outside Al Kharid amongst piles of debris, they did. 'Tis a troublin' time to be a cap'n!

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.player: Oh that doesn't sound good at all!

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.npc: It isn't, but worry not. The Spirit Anglers 'ave been formed t' tackle this beastie! We're recruiting all skilled sailors and fisherfolk t' help us.

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.text: If the player does not have the required Fishing level:

steps.npc: Are you sure? It's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.

steps.text: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.

at-ruins-of-unkah-initial-dialogue.text: If the player has the required Fishing level:

steps.npc: Excellent!
The ships on the dock regularly embark to Tempoross Cove. Once there, you'll need to keep the cannons loaded with Harpoonfish t' weaken the Spirit. You can fish 'em on the island.
When Tempoross submerges, get up close and clear the fish from its whirlpools; they're how it gets its energy.
Aye, that be the easy part!
The storm of Tempoross will rage around you, so you better be ready to deal with lightning strikes and avoid getting zapped when Tempoross attacks the cannons.
Also, watch out for those mighty waves! You'll want t' tether yourself t' something solid so you don't find yourself lost in the deep blue when they come crashing down!

steps.player: Oh... Well, I suppose I can do that.
Will I need any special equipment?

steps.npc: Everythin' you need can be found on-board. Though if you have a favourite harpoon, you can always bring that!
The complete Spirit Anglers outfit also has an 'andy harness built-in, so you won't need a rope if you're wearin' it. You can speak t' Gita about getting one.
Ye can find Gita just east of 'ere, next t' some fishin' equipment.
When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!

options.text: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?

steps.player: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?

steps.speaker: Captain Pudi:
steps.text: Other than maintainin' safe passage and savin' lives?!

steps.npc: I'm just messin' with ye! Of course there are benefits!
We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!
Some of the more resourceful Spirit Anglers also discovered a fishing use for the spirit energised scales shed by the fish within Tempoross. You're free t' keep any you find.

steps.player: Can you remind me what to do on the island?

options.text: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?

steps.npc: Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
I was sitting down by the shore enjoying one of Karim's kebabs at the time, when suddenly the crew washed up amongst a pile of debris. Looked like they'd just seen a ghost!
As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit!
Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!
Don't ask me what the ruins used to be. And it's not like Menaphos can 'ave a say!
Whatever they are, they make a fine base for the Spirit Anglers!
Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.
I like t' get stuck in, me-self; face off toe t' toe with the beastie. I'll be right by your side when you go out there!
I'm still 'ere, ain't I?
Anyway, there's plenty o' research going on, so maybe you can find some notes lyin' around if ye want to know more.

at-ruins-of-unkah-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Ahoy there! What can I 'elp ye with?

at-ruins-of-unkah-attempting-to-board-th.npc: Sorry, it's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.

at-ruins-of-unkah-attempting-to-board-th.text: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.

at-tempoross-cove.npc: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!

steps.npc: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.

Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!

options.text: What should I watch out for?

steps.player: What should I watch out for?

steps.npc: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.

Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.

options.text: Yes, I really want to leave.

steps.player: Yes, I really want to leave.

options.text: No, I don't want to leave.

steps.player: No, I don't want to leave.

options.text: I'll get on with the fighting.

steps.player: I'll get on with the fighting.

at-tempoross-cove-after-subduing-temporo.npc: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!

steps.npc: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
Aye aye!

steps.text: The player returns to the Ruins of Unkah.

succeeding-in-subduing-tempoross-with-no.npc: Excellent work out there! The seas are safe for a little longer thanks to you!
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!

failing-to-subdue-tempoross.npc: Argh, we let that storm grow too fierce... As soon as it's safe we'll 'ead straight back out!

overhead-dialogue-at-ruins-of-unkah.text: If there are no players on the ship:

steps.npc: Join the Spirit Anglers!
Plenty of room for more adventurers!
Come and help us fight Tempoross!
It'll be worth your while...

overhead-dialogue-at-ruins-of-unkah.text: If a player boards the ship:

steps.npc: To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
Let's get underway!

overhead-dialogue-at-ruins-of-unkah.text: If all players exit the ship before the mission begins:

steps.npc: Belay that! We'll try again later.

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: As soon as the mission begins:

steps.npc: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: If Tempoross uses the colossal wave attack:

steps.npc: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!

steps.text: If the nearby mast has been damaged from the wave attack:

steps.npc: The mast has been damaged!

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: If Tempoross uses the lightning attack:

steps.npc: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: If Tempoross uses the water torrent attack on one of the nearby cannons:

steps.npc: Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: If Tempoross surfaces from the water:

steps.npc: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
Tempoross has retreated to the depths!

overhead-dialogue-at-tempoross-cove.text: If Tempoross has not been subdued after becoming vulnerable for the third time:

steps.npc: Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
